payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance whose combat starts, when the command names no target
payload.initiative: object — { <PC character id>: integer }: the initiative the DM enters for each PC with a token on the instance; one missing is refused, one of a PC with no token is ignored
payload.rolls: object — optional, { <NPC token id>: integer from 1 to 20 }: the d20 an NPC token rolled at the table; a token with none rolls at random. Each NPC's initiative is its roll plus its DEX modifier (Initiative@1)
payload.entry: object — never sent by the DM: the command's own follow-ups, one per participant, each seating one initiative entry of the combat the start opened (initiativeEntryId, initiativeEntryCombatId, initiativeEntryTokenId, roll, initiative, dexScore, tiebreak, rank); refused once the entry is seated, or when its combat is not open
